$comment: WS4 rows: the Exhaust Blow order on the valve station (B2, manual only per 00 D5), its tunables and its text.

General/Settings/Damage Control.$comment: Air units led into the ballast per diesel crankshaft revolution (03 §2.A).
The middle tanks get exhaust once both end tanks hold less water than this (03 §2.A).
The blow is finished when the main ballast holds at most this much water in total (03 §7.3 epsilon).
Below this the diesel counts as stopped (03 §7.4).
Deck depth in metres below which the deck counts as above water; 0 is the waterline (03 §7.4).
A running blow is cancelled after the diesel or deck gate has failed this long without a break (game seconds).

Locales/Activators.English: Lead the running diesel's exhaust into the main ballast tanks and drive the rest of the water out. Saves the compressed-air bottles. Only works on the surface with the diesel running; the faster it turns, the faster the tanks empty.
Emptying the ballast tanks with diesel exhaust

Locales/Actions.English: The deck must be clear of the water.
The ballast tanks are already empty.
